SELECT contract.id, contract.info_val2, contract.info_val, main.cust_name, main.cust_grp_name, contract.info_val2 as svc_num FROM zqzt_grp_contract_other_info contract LEFT JOIN ZQZT_CUST_MAINT_INFO main ON contract.info_val = main.user_id WHERE contract.contract_id = #{contractId} AND contract.info_tag = 'GRP_CONTRACT_USER_LIST' AND contract.IS_VALID = 1 and main.cust_id is not null
AND contract.info_val2 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{infoVal2}, '%')
ORDER BY contract.create_time DESC
